The '''Stromma contingent''' was a contingent of [[Stromma]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who served the [[Empire of the Hand]]. [[Commanding officer/Legends|Commanded]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], the force was made up of several Stromma who traveled aboard several [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] and [[Nyama's shuttle]] to and from their headquarters on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stromma contingent appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' novella, published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
